description: Theo keeps the key to the family's inherited backyard beehive and must decide how to position it, when to restore the colony, and how to distribute its first usable honey, with input from his sister Nia, cousin Ravi, and aunt Celeste.

shared_context.S1: The family inherited one honeybee hive from their grandfather, and it is currently in a stand beside the backyard patio.
shared_context.S2: Theo has the apiary key and is making the family plan for the hive.
shared_context.S3: The hive needs routine care this spring, and the family hopes to use some honey later in the year.
shared_context.S4: At the Sunday family check-in, Theo asks each person for anything that should shape the hive plan before he settles it.
shared_context.S5: The family has agreed that the hive should remain part of their shared family activities.

PF1.text: Nia's neighbor has a severe bee allergy, so the hive must be moved to the far east fence at least 50 feet from the patio and protected by a screened barrier; Nia has not raised this with Theo yet.

PF2.text: Ravi inspected the hive for a local beekeeper and found that it is queenless; the beekeeper recommends introducing a new queen by 2026-05-15 and not harvesting honey before 2026-06-01, but Ravi has not shared the inspection yet.

PF3.text: Celeste promised twelve jars from the first harvest to the Willow Street Hospice fundraiser, which needs them delivered by 2026-08-20; she has not mentioned the promise to the family group.

acceptance_conditions: The hive must be moved to the far east fence at least 50 feet from the patio.
A screened barrier must be required around the hive.
A new queen must be introduced by 2026-05-15.
Honey harvesting must not be allowed before 2026-06-01.
Exactly twelve jars must be reserved for the Willow Street Hospice fundraiser.
The twelve jars must be delivered by 2026-08-20.
The plan must include a commitment to install the screened barrier.
The plan must include a commitment to introduce the new queen.
The plan must include a commitment to deliver the hospice jars.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] in ['screened_barrier_installation', 'hive_relocation', 'immediate_action', 'relocation', 'safety'] and c['target'] in ['Nia', "Nia's neighbor"] and 'screened barrier' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] in ['queen_introduction', 'requeening', 'hive_health'] and 'May 15' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] in ['hospice_honey_delivery', 'hospice_donation', 'hospice_commitment', 'hospice_fundraiser', 'hospice_delivery', 'community_commitment', 'harvest_timing'] and '12' in c['detail'] and ('August 20' in c['detail'] or '2026-08-20' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Nia's allergy information changes the hive location to the far east fence, sets the patio separation at at least 50 feet, requires a screened barrier, and creates the barrier-installation commitment.
Ravi's inspection changes the colony plan by requiring queen introduction on 2026-05-15 and delaying harvest until 2026-06-01, with a matching queen-introduction commitment.
Celeste's fundraiser promise changes the honey allocation to exactly 12 jars, fixes delivery for 2026-08-20, and creates the hospice-honey delivery commitment.
